CustomField.description: Numeric field display override (#254), following the per-datatype *Type__c override family. Applies to number, currency, and percent fields: standard renders the normal input; stepper renders minus/plus buttons flanking the formatted input; slider renders a lightning-slider with a formatted readout (bounds from the field's Min/Max params, percent defaulting 0-100); presetamounts renders admin-defined amount chips from numberPresets__c with an inline custom input.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Overrides how a numeric field displays on the form. Stepper adds minus and plus buttons, Slider renders a draggable range with a readout, and Preset Amounts offers configured quick-pick values. The field's currency or percent formatting applies in every mode.
CustomField.label: numberType
